## Closed per the maintainer's ruling: **B**. The umbrella closes, and each remaining item is re-homed or declined

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T06:08Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

The maintainer answered 「同意」 in the live PM chat with the triage seat to option **B** of triage's long-project batch 1 (item ②).
- **A** was to keep this p0.
- **B** is this close.
- **C** was to downgrade it to p2.

This card had had no delivery since 2026-08-03 while holding `priority:p0`. The done work stays done.

| item | where it goes |
|:--|:--|
| Phase 0, the Connect page, the Claude Code plugin, the one-click buttons, the Gemini extension | ✅ **done** (checked on this card) |
| ChatGPT connectors verification, Codex CLI verification, the metadata-only registry listings | → **#20791** (p3, one carrier) |
| Anthropic connector directory | → objectstack-ai/cloud#786 (unchanged; it owns the multi-tenant entry shape) |
| Agent-framework recipes, n8n / Zapier / Make | **not done** until a named user asks. That is this card's own demand gate, and nothing is lost: the list above is the record |

`os-zhuang`'s assignment comes off with the close.
